job: Rebuild the Shine V4 public marketing page and article to demonstrate the final open-source design director, with before-and-after proof, a downloadable SKILL.md, and a clear conversion path
primaryTask: Understand why Shine V4 is materially better, inspect the proof, and get the complete skill without needing GitHub or a terminal.

defects.problem: The primary path is split between a technical essay, a distant write-up link, and a skill action near the bottom of a 4,255px page.
defects.evidence: The live baseline places the first product action in the nav, while the explanatory conversion section begins after five long text sections.
defects.expectedEffect: Place one clear Get Shine action and one evidence action in the hero, then repeat the install path after the proof.

defects.problem: The page describes V3 internals but does not prove the V4 reference strategy, cross-media lanes, interaction result, or the rebuild itself.
defects.evidence: The baseline contains two small UI comparisons and a file listing, but no V4 contract, before/after narrative, or visible output-lane model.
defects.expectedEffect: Make the V4 architecture, dogfood receipt, downloadable skill, and working interaction explicit and testable.

defects.problem: The page reads as a narrow article column with evenly weighted paragraphs, so the product proof never becomes the focal object.
defects.evidence: At 1280px the content occupies a thin central column and the three catalog images render as thumbnails beneath multiple paragraphs.
defects.expectedEffect: Use an evidence-led hero and a wide visual proof stage so the before/after and director loop establish hierarchy within three seconds.

defects.problem: The visual language is clean but collapses into the same neutral shadcn editorial treatment the product is meant to help agents move beyond.
defects.evidence: The baseline has excellent axe and contrast results, but nearly every surface is white, zinc, one-pixel bordered, and equally rounded.
defects.expectedEffect: Retain the accessibility floor while introducing a distinctive editorial-tech composition, purposeful image treatment, and one signature proof visual.
